text:
Alex (Partnerships): Quick sync — cloud marketplace asked for a refreshed private-offer framework that bundles HW + reserved commit. Need a launch plan and renewal mechanics.
Maria (Sales): Important: keep renewals simple. Customers hate nested SKUs. Propose two commit paths: `Reserved-Only` and `Reserved+Appliance`. Discounts tiered by 12/24/36 months.
Danielle (Pricing): +1. Protect margin though. My initial proposal: 12mo/24mo/36mo list discounts = 20% / 25% / 30%. HW credits applied as a percent of committed spend (not separate SKU) to avoid SKU sprawl.
Ryan (PM): Marketplace listing question — can we show an "appliance credit included" badge publicly or is that only visible via private offer metadata?
Alex (Partnerships): Marketplace UI requires a public SKU, badge can be surfaced via private-offer metadata + partner-provided banner. We'll need cloud partner signoff for the banner. @Maria can you bring in the SI contact for co-announcement planning?
Maria (Sales): Looping in the SI contact is in progress. Also quick one on renewals: do we auto-offer a top-up if customer hits high utilization before renewal? That helps retention.
Danielle (Pricing): We can include an auto-topup clause but capped to protect economics. Draft clause: "If usage >= 80% of committed monthly average within last 30 days, customer becomes eligible for one-time top-up at 50% of standard overage rate for remaining term." Need Legal sign-off.
Danielle (Pricing): Draft mapping (for clarity):
`12mo: discount=20%, hw_credit=10%`
`24mo: discount=25%, hw_credit=15%`
`36mo: discount=30%, hw_credit=20%`
Ryan (PM): Product ask: Console needs telemetry + flags: `commit_consumption_pct`, `topup_eligibility`, and a pipeline to surface marketplace-private-offer metadata. I'll spin up an infra ticket.
Alex (Partnerships): I'll own partner comms (partner deck + one-pager). For announcement cadence: suggest co-led blog for SI-heavy deals + marketplace listing update and a short partner case study.
Maria (Sales): Timeline check: sales wants private offers enabled in marketplace by EOW Q2. Is that feasible?
Danielle (Pricing): Feasible if legal + cloud partner approvals in ~6 weeks. I'll produce a formal mapping spreadsheet for approvals (tiers, discounts, hw_credit %, renewal/topup language).
Alex (Partnerships): Action items: Danielle -> mapping doc + contract language; Maria -> confirm SI contact + co-annc preference; Ryan -> console telemetry ticket; Alex -> partner comms draft and cloud partner kickoff.
Alex (Partnerships): Also thinking about runway for renewals: add a 90-day renewal alert in Console for sales ops to prep offers.
CI-Bot: Reminder: Partner sync Tue 10am PT — added to calendar. :calendar: :rocket:
